guidance:
Assess current incident disposition, population pattern, causal explanation,
practical value and evidence coverage separately. Recovery of current work can
coexist with a systemic improvement opportunity.

The supplied external App population is also within this review's scope. Assess
its observations even when the exact Task is healthy; identify Task-level and
App-level conclusions separately. State whether an overall rate change remains
after comparing the supplied executor populations. Preserve units: an attempt is
not a Task or a delivered contribution.

Aggregate counts establish frequency in the stated population. Recorded durations
establish observed effort. Treat the cause, avoidability and recovery of other
inputs as unassessed until their process or input/operation links support those
claims. Use workload breakdowns and contrasting examples to check interpretations.
An incorrect output establishes an output defect; unavailable execution history
leaves the procedure that produced it unknown.

Recommend the smallest useful investigation when a material pattern is supported
but its cause is uncertain. A candidate or immediate action needs a separate
value-versus-cost judgment. Retain independently supported current recovery,
quality findings and evidence gaps in the same report.

Use the supplied code-calculated comparison table for numerical claims. Recovery counts refer only to input-correlated evidence; an unresolved attribution is not a recovered incident.
